messages:
Jordan (Support): customer report — promo code 'SPARK-TRIAL-14' rejected as invalid during checkout. Dashboard shows code active with 14 days left. Customer email: carlos@keystone.app, org_id org_8312. They pasted API response: {"error": "promo_invalid_or_expired"} and request-id: req_0a9f3c. Happened 2026-03-14 09:12 UTC. Can someone triage?

Maya C.: can you paste the exact checkout request they used (headers + body)? sometimes client timezone header causes us to evaluate expiry incorrectly.

Jordan (Support): pasted from customer:
```
POST /v1/checkout/apply_promo
Host: api.redwood.ai
Authorization: Bearer sk-***
Content-Type: application/json
X-Client-Timezone: America/Sao_Paulo
{
  "org_id":"org_8312",
  "promo_code":"SPARK-TRIAL-14",
  "user_email":"carlos@keystone.app"
}
```
API response: 400 {"error":"promo_invalid_or_expired","code":"promo_invalid_or_expired"} req: req_0a9f3c

Alex R.: quick repro curl that support can run (include debug headers):
```
curl -v -H "Authorization: Bearer sk-REDACTED" -H "X-Client-Timezone: America/Sao_Paulo" -d '{"org_id":"org_8312","promo_code":"SPARK-TRIAL-14","user_email":"carlos@keystone.app"}' https://api.redwood.ai/v1/checkout/apply_promo
```
Run that against staging first. If you get same 400 include response headers (x-request-id + x-promo-status).

Samir L.: I pulled the promo-service logs for SPARK-TRIAL-14 around that time. DB tells me: status=active, expires_at=2026-03-28T00:00:00Z. BUT redis cache shows key promo:SPARK-TRIAL-14.status=archived with TTL -1. Looks like the cache eviction job mistakenly flipped a flag. Log snippet: 
```
2026-03-14T00:00:02Z promo-evict-job INFO evicting prefix=promo:archived_key_mismatch
2026-03-14T00:00:02Z promo-cache SET promo:SPARK-TRIAL-14.status archived (ttl=-1)
2026-03-14T00:00:02Z promo-service WARN validate_promo promo=SPARK-TRIAL-14 code_status=archived cache_origin=redis
```
So API reads cache first and returns invalid. DB is correct.

promo-bot: lookup complete — SPARK-TRIAL-14 meta: created_by=marketing:internal, scope=global, last_modified=2026-03-14T00:00:00Z, dashboard_state=active

billing-bot: automated-note — no charges applied. customer eligible for trial grant.

Maya C.: ok good catch. If DB is authoritative we can either invalidate the cache entry or force a read-through. Support, can you ask Ops to run: `redis.del("promo:SPARK-TRIAL-14.status")` as a hotfix?

Jordan (Support): assigning manual credit workflow in the meantime — customer is blocked on onboarding. I'll request a manual 14-day trial grant and let them proceed. Samir, can you run the redis delete?

Samir L.: running now — removed key, flushed local cache for the node that reported it. After deletion the validate path falls back to DB and returns active. I see a successful validate call: 
```
promo-service validate SPARK-TRIAL-14 -> status=active source=db
```

eng-oncall: root cause tracked — eviction job used an outdated key-prefix after a config rename (promo: -> promo:) and accidentally set archived marker on some codes during the midnight maintenance window. Patch queued to avoid writing negative TTL flags and ensure atomic compare-before-set. Will deploy hotfix within 2 hours; will follow up with postmortem. Ticket ENG-3521 created.

Jordan (Support): left a note to customer: "Thanks — we manually reactivated your code and applied the 14-day trial to your account while we fix the backend. Sorry for the interruption, we'll follow up when root cause is fully resolved." Customer replied: :thumbsup: "works now, thanks" (confirmed they could apply the credit).

Alex R.: follow-up actions for PM/infra: 1) make cache eviction job idempotent + test, 2) add a metric/alert for archive writes with TTL=-1, 3) add health-check that compares cached status vs DB for random sample.

Jordan (Support): marking thread resolved for now — manual credit applied, customer onboarded. Will update ticket ENG-3521 with timestamps and the customer impact so PM can prioritize rollback/fix.
